findings: The complete body-curried calibration reference remains unchanged and passes all centered, reflected-effect, and shifted-context cases.
Removing persistent nonzero drive preserves the first useful move and return but restores the exact unresolved stall at position 2.
Merging persistent drive with action-caused Transition incidence makes the worsening move from -3 to -4 write false closure; the complete reference writes none.
Adding ordinary drive at residual zero makes an initially normal body act, while the complete reference remains output-free at zero.
The first fixed-context arm is honestly retained as falsified because its any-window oracle accepted transient [3, 3, 2, 2] passage through the shifted band.
The separately frozen successor distinguishes terminal residence: complete calibration finishes inside shifted [2, 3], while fixed calibration finishes [1, 1, 1, 1] inside its old centered relation.
All removals are test-only transformations of existing PhysicalInput values; production calibration, trace topology, core choice, and motor effects are unchanged.
Every surviving arm replays exactly and naturally quiesces, both convergence records validate, and the independently timed warm regression is 0.51 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: Necessity is bounded to the declared scalar world, two anonymous motors, thirty-two observations, and a four-observation terminal projection.
The result does not establish that body norms develop autonomously, change online, or compose collectively across several attached sensors.
It does not establish real finger hand eye ear vocal speech workstation or arbitrary-morphology competence.
The worktree remains dirty development state; this is candidate evidence, not a clean authority or default-protocol promotion.
